text:
```yaml
name: Check Milestone and Build

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [release/7.0]
  push:
    branches: [release/7.0]

jobs:
  check-milestone:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Verify PR milestone
        uses: actions/github-script@v6
        with:
          script: |
            const pr = await github.rest.pulls.get({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              pull_number: context.payload.pull_request.number
            });
            const milestone = pr.data.milestone;
            if (!milestone) {
              core.setFailed('PR does not have a milestone set.');
            } else if (milestone.title !== '7.0') {
              core.setFailed(`PR milestone is "${milestone.title}". Expected "7.0".`);
            }

  build-and-test:
    runs-on: windows-latest
    needs: check-milestone
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup .NET
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
        with:
          dotnet-version: '7.0.x'

      - name: Restore dependencies
        run: dotnet restore

      - name: Build solution
        run: dotnet build --configuration Release --no-restore

      - name: Run tests
        run: dotnet test --configuration Release --no-build --verbosity normal
```
